globalPromptSuffix: Production game SFX. Dry, clean, isolated and mixable. No speech, music, melody, beat, or watermark.

layers.instruction: Render the complete polished sound effect as one cohesive one-shot with a clear attack, material body, restrained secondary detail, and short natural decay.
Render only the immediate transient attack. Crisp and short. No sustained body, debris sequence, ambience, or reverb tail.
Render only the central weight and material resonance. No sharp initial attack, loose debris, ambience bed, or long decay.
Render only small secondary texture, grit, chips, particles, relay movement, or interface detail appropriate to the event. No primary impact or long reverb.
Render only the natural decay after the event. Begin after the imagined main hit. No new attack, repeated event, constant ambience, or music.
Render the complete polished seamless environmental loop, balanced and restrained, with no audible beginning, ending, click, musical rhythm, or dominant event.
Render a seamless loop containing only the low-frequency environmental pressure bed. Stable level, no accents, melody, voices, or audible seam.
Render a seamless loop containing only the mid-frequency physical motion and material texture. No low drone, sharp accents, voices, rhythm, or audible seam.
Render a seamless loop containing only subtle high-frequency air, grit, particle, or mechanism detail. Sparse, no body drone, music, voices, or audible seam.
Render a seamless sparse accent layer with isolated irregular physical events and silence between them. No constant bed, music, voices, rhythm, or audible seam.
